nphi.with: UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA); WHO Regional Office for Europe
nphi.summary: In 2023, IANPHI and UKHSA colleagues joined a WHO Europe reference group supporting the development of Azerbaijan's public health institutions.

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: UKHSA–KDCA memorandum of understanding on health security
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.summary: MoU covering preparedness and response, VHF outbreak monitoring, laboratory capacity, AMR and IPC, immunisation policy, pathogen data sharing and staff exchanges.

nphi.title: ZNPHI study visit to NCDC Nigeria and joint EOC simulation exercise
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC); UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA)
nphi.summary: ZNPHI's director-general led a March 2022 delegation, accompanied by UKHSA, to NCDC to observe a multi-state emergency operations centre simulation exercise and discuss a peer-to-peer exchange programme between the two institutes.

nphi.title: TEPHINET–IANPHI climate and health webinar series for field epidemiologists
nphi.with: TEPHINET; UK Health Security Agency; US CDC; Columbia University Global Consortium on Climate and Health Education
nphi.summary: Monthly 2022 webinars (heat, wildfires, vector-borne disease, air pollution, flooding) delivered by NPHI experts and FETP alumni, run through the TEPHINET Climate and Health Working Group that includes IANPHI, UKHSA and US CDC.

nphi.title: JA TERROR – Preparedness and response to biological and chemical terror attacks
nphi.with: Sciensano; RIVM; NIJZ; Serbian and UK partner institutes not named on the source page
nphi.summary: Strengthened cross-sector preparedness of health systems for biological and chemical terror attacks, including links between health and security services and a simulation exercise.

nphi.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
nphi.with: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
nphi.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.

nphi.title: ENTRANT – East and Southern African Consortium for Outbreak Epidemiology Training
nphi.actor: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); National Health Laboratory Botswana; University of Nairobi; ZAMBART; Haramaya University; Mwanza Intervention Trials Unit; Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC-funded consortium offering master's-level outbreak epidemiology training in East and Southern Africa, with UVRI among the African partners.

nphi.title: IDEA Fellowship – Research-based fellowship training in infectious disease epidemiology and biostatistics
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); The Open University; Ministry of Health Uganda; Makerere University; UNCST; Mbale Clinical Research Institute
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC consortium that created research-based epidemiology and biostatistics fellowships in Uganda, partnering with UVRI and the UK's Open University.

nphi.title: UKHSA – US CDC partnership on pandemic preparedness and genomic surveillance
nphi.with: UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) and its Centre for Pandemic Preparedness; NHS Race and Health Observatory
nphi.summary: Agreed in June 2021, the partnership links UKHSA with CDC's Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics on disease surveillance, global genomic sequencing capacity, a pathogen surveillance network and joint trials; a parallel strand…

nphi.title: Belmont Forum: Community collective action on climate change and the environment–health nexus
nphi.with: University College London; RAND Corporation; University of the West Indies; University of Oslo
nphi.summary: Comparative study of how volunteer community groups in Alaska and Trinidad and Tobago organise to respond to climate-related health impacts, aimed at informing health-system resilience planning.

nphi.title: EMiL – European standards for mobile diagnostic laboratories
nphi.with: UK Public Health Rapid Support Team; Public Health England; Institut Pasteur (France); Rospotrebnadzor (Russia); CTMA UCLouvain (Belgium); WHO EURO; GOARN; BNITM; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology (Germany)
nphi.summary: Developed minimum standards and audit for rapid response mobile labs and links to EMTs.

nphi.title: Welsh Government – WHO/Europe collaboration agreement on health equity
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Venice Office); Welsh Government
nphi.summary: Agreement between the Welsh Government and WHO/Europe, implemented by Public Health Wales, on health equity solutions, well-being economy approaches and capacity building; renewed in 2023.

nphi.title: Africa Pathogen Genomics Initiative (Africa PGI)
nphi.with: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation; US CDC; Microsoft; Illumina; Oxford Nanopore Technologies
nphi.summary: USD 100 million, four-year public-private partnership launched in October 2020 to build a continental network of sequencing laboratories, bioinformatics, data systems and trained staff for genomic surveillance.

nphi.title: SHARP JA – Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Wales (UK partner); THL (coordinator); RIVM; NIJZ; AGES; Switzerland took part as a collaborating partner with its own funding
nphi.summary: A joint action to help countries implement the International Health Regulations and strengthen preparedness for serious cross-border health threats, including laboratory capacity and chemical threats.

nphi.title: SYSVAC – Global registry of systematic reviews on vaccines
nphi.with: WHO (Switzerland); London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (UK)
nphi.summary: Built a free registry of vaccine systematic reviews and e-learning for NITAGs.

nphi.title: PHE – Qatar Ministry of Public Health memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Ministry of Public Health, Qatar (Public Health Department)
nphi.summary: An MoU signed in 2019 at the first Qatar Public Health Conference to strengthen bilateral cooperation on public health communication, exchange of expertise, academic activities and research.

nphi.title: PHE–WHO AFRO memorandum of understanding on IHR capacity
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Africa (WHO AFRO)
nphi.summary: Five-year framework MoU signed April–May 2019 for technical collaboration to strengthen African countries' International Health Regulations (2005) capacities, with activities set out in addenda.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Pakistan (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health (NIH) Islamabad; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; Health Security Partners; Indus Hospital Health Network; Shifa International Hospital; Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan
nphi.summary: DAI-led Fleming Fund grant that strengthened Pakistan's One Health AMR surveillance, including ISO 15189 accreditation, whole-genome sequencing and GLASS reporting at NIH, which hosts the national AMR secretariat.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Viet Nam (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (NIHE, sub-grantee); National Institute of Veterinary Research (NIVR); OUCRU; PATH
nphi.summary: FHI 360 led the Fleming Fund grant in Viet Nam with NIHE as a sub-grantee, supporting One Health AMR governance, designation of national AMR reference labs and AMR/AMU surveillance.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Timor-Leste
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INSP); Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries
nphi.summary: With Fleming Fund country-grant support, Menzies works with Timor-Leste's National Health Laboratory, INSP and ministries to build microbiology and AMR surveillance capacity.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Kenya – Phase 1
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI); University of Nairobi; Aga Khan University; Washington State University; National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL)
nphi.summary: PATH led Kenya's first Fleming Fund country grant (2019) within a six-institution consortium including KEMRI and ILRI, building active and passive AMR surveillance and lab capacity across human and animal health.

nphi.title: Media relations training for NCDC leadership (2019 and 2022)
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); US CDC; Tony Blair Institute for Global Change
nphi.summary: IANPHI-designed media relations workshops in Abuja for senior NCDC staff in August 2019 (with US CDC and Tony Blair Institute) and May 2022, using outbreak scenarios and mock interviews to strengthen risk communication.

nphi.title: PANDORA-ID-NET – Pan-African Network for Rapid Research, Response, Relief and Preparedness for Infectious Disease Epidemics
nphi.actor: Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); INMI Lazzaro Spallanzani (Italy); University College London; Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital; University of Zambia; Ifakara Health Institute; CERMEL Lambaréné; KNUST/KCCR; Charité; University of Tübingen
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded One Health consortium of African and European institutions preparing for rapid research and response to infectious disease outbreaks; Nigeria's NCDC, Tanzania's NIMR and UVRI were among the African partners and Italy's…

nphi.title: PHE–NIMHANS collaboration on mental health and public health observatories
nphi.with: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS), Bengaluru
nphi.summary: MoU signed in August 2018 to develop collaborative programmes on mental health and public health system models, including support for India's first Public Health Observatory.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Nepal
nphi.with: National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL); Central Veterinary Laboratory; AMR Containment Multisectoral Steering Committee; WHO; FAO
nphi.summary: FHI 360 implemented the Fleming Fund country grant in Nepal, building AMR/AMU surveillance capacity in human and animal health together with the National Public Health Laboratory and Central Veterinary Laboratory.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Sierra Leone Country Grant (human health, WHO)
nphi.with: National Public Health Agency (NPHA); Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security; FAO; Connaught Hospital; Ola During Children's Hospital
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund support implemented by WHO with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and National Public Health Agency built microbiology labs, stewardship training and the country's first GLASS AMR data submission.

nphi.title: PHE – NCDC MoU launching the IHR strengthening programme in Nigeria
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Abuja on 2 Oct 2018 on surveillance, emergency response, laboratories and workforce, part of a 16 million GBP UK programme across five countries.

nphi.title: Joint WHO Europe–IANPHI seminars on building NPHIs through mergers
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Regional Office for Europe; merged NPHIs of Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden, UK
nphi.summary: WHO Europe and IANPHI held three seminars, in Kyiv (2017), Warsaw (2018) and Moldova (April 2019). Merged NPHIs from Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden and the UK shared their experience with countries setting up NPHIs: Ukraine, Moldova,…

nphi.title: ALERRT – African coaLition for Epidemic Research, Response and Training
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: China–UK Global Health project on public health capacity in Sierra Leone
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Sanitation Sierra Leone; Sierra Leone-China Friendship Biological Safety Laboratory; Sierra Leone-China Friendship Hospital; Public Health England (UK partner)
nphi.summary: Under the China-UK Global Health Support Programme, China CDC worked with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and with Public Health England. Together they set up bacteriology and parasitology labs, wrote SOPs (cholera, typhoid, malaria…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 054 – Medical preparedness and response to CBRN incidents in the Middle East
nphi.with: Sustainable Criminal Justice Solutions (SCJS)
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Public Health England and SCJS equipped CBRN training centres, trained master trainers and developed Arabic/English SOPs for medical CBRN response in Iraq, Jordan and Lebanon.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – LSHTM memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
nphi.summary: Cooperation MoU between Fiocruz and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.

nphi.title: China CDC – PHE/UKHSA cooperation (MoUs 2015 and 2018)
nphi.with: Public Health England / UK Health Security Agency
nphi.summary: China CDC signed MoUs with Public Health England in 2015 and 2018, covering exchanges on salt reduction, emergency response, lab safety, environmental health and vaccine evaluation. A 2022 heads-of-agency meeting with UKHSA continued the…

nphi.title: PHE–China CDC memoranda of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: PHE and China CDC signed MoUs in 2015 and 2018 underpinning exchanges on salt reduction, emergency response, lab safety, environmental health and vaccine evaluation; UKHSA and China CDC discussed continuing these in 2022.

nphi.title: Resilient Zero – post-Ebola laboratory and emergency-planning reconstruction in Sierra Leone
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone; Connaught Hospital; Bo and Makeni regional hospitals
nphi.summary: UK Aid-funded £4.5M PHE project that refurbished three national laboratories, trained MoHS staff in molecular diagnostics and ~300 civil servants in emergency planning, and supported IHR work and plans for a Sierra Leone public health…

nphi.title: ICMR – UK Medical Research Council MoU and joint calls
nphi.with: UK Medical Research Council (MRC)
nphi.summary: ICMR and the UK MRC signed an MoU in November 2015, building on joint funding calls that started in 2010 (chronic non-communicable diseases) and 2014 (substance misuse and mental health).

nphi.title: ICMR – LSHTM memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
nphi.summary: ICMR signed an MoU with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in July 2015 for research cooperation.

nphi.title: PHE Ebola diagnostic laboratories in Sierra Leone
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone; Ebola Treatment Centres at Kerry Town, Port Loko and Makeni
nphi.summary: During the 2014–2015 West African Ebola epidemic PHE set up and staffed three molecular diagnostic laboratories attached to Ebola treatment centres in Sierra Leone.

nphi.title: PHE mentoring of UVRI communications
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); IANPHI
nphi.summary: IANPHI-initiated partnership in which PHE assessed and mentored UVRI's public communications (website, social media, media relations, annual reporting) in 2013, part of IANPHI's long-term support to UVRI since 2006.

nphi.title: HPA and US CDC partnership on UVRI's 5-year strategic plan
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); US CDC
nphi.summary: In 2007, under IANPHI, the UK Health Protection Agency and US CDC worked with UVRI on its 5-year strategic plan and the systems work linked to it.

nphi.title: Strengthening of IEDCR project (ODA/DFID)
nphi.actor: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR)
nphi.with: UK Overseas Development Administration (later DFID)
nphi.summary: UK-funded project from 1991 to 1996 to strengthen Bangladesh's national epidemiology and disease control institute; the support ended early when the donor reorganised.

nphi.title: North/South NPHI collaboration England–South Africa
nphi.with: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), South Africa
nphi.summary: A peer partnership between the English and South African national public health institutes that shared expertise, supported IHR implementation and built health-protection capacity. It was presented as a model for global health protection…

nphi.title: Dual-function TB subunit vaccine
nphi.with: Center for Infectious Disease Research (CIDR); Public Health England
nphi.summary: An NIH-funded TB vaccine research collaboration between SSI, CIDR in the US and Public Health England.

nphi.title: China–UK–Tanzania Pilot Project on Malaria Control
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Ifakara Health Institute; National Malaria Control Programme (Tanzania); UK DFID
nphi.summary: A roughly three-year pilot under the DFID-backed China–UK Global Health Support Programme in which NIPD and Ifakara Health Institute applied a paired 'learning by doing' malaria control approach in Tanzania. It was followed by a…

nphi.title: Commonwealth Health Protection Policy and Planning Toolkit
nphi.with: Commonwealth Secretariat
nphi.summary: Public Health Wales helped the Commonwealth Secretariat develop a health protection policy and planning toolkit, field-tested in Sierra Leone, as part of its international health strategy.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Nigeria – Phase 2
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare; Federal Ministries of Environment and Agriculture; Mott MacDonald (Fleming Fund Management Agent); WHO; FAO
nphi.summary: MSH leads the UK-funded Fleming Fund phase 2 country grant in Nigeria, working with NCDC and sector ministries to improve One Health AMR surveillance data, analysis and use.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Papua New Guinea
nphi.with: Central Public Health Laboratory (CPHL, planned national AMR reference lab); National Department of Health; Department of Agriculture and Livestock; NAQIA; CEPA; Port Moresby General Hospital; Doherty Institute
nphi.summary: Burnet Institute leads the Fleming Fund grant in PNG, renovating the Central Public Health Laboratory as the national AMR reference lab and strengthening One Health AMR data surveillance with the National Department of Health.

nphi.title: Antibiotic dispensing by private drug sellers in Indonesia
nphi.with: Gadjah Mada University; Sebelas Maret University; LSHTM; George Institute for Global Health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$1.91 million) studying how private drug sellers dispense antibiotics and testing interventions to curb self-medication driving AMR.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Zimbabwe (FAO)
nphi.actor: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
nphi.with: UK Department of Health and Social Care (Fleming Fund); Fleming Fund management agent
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund grant delivered by FAO to improve AMR and antimicrobial use data and support antibiotic stewardship in Zimbabwe; listed as post-completion on DevTracker.

nphi.title: Global Pathogen Analysis Platform (GPAP)
nphi.actor: Technical University of Denmark (DTU) with Statens Serum Institut
nphi.with: Statens Serum Institut; University of Copenhagen; Imperial College London; unnamed collaborators in Europe, Africa and Asia; funded by Novo Nordisk Foundation
nphi.summary: AI and bioinformatics platform for One Health pathogen surveillance being built at DTU with SSI, Copenhagen and Imperial, to be developed and piloted with researchers and health authorities in low- and middle-income countries over six…

highlights.headline: UK citizen brought back from DRC for specialist Ebola care
highlights.why: This is a concrete Ebola precaution with a DRC link, and it bears on UK preparedness and on coordination with partners on cases linked to the outbreak.

highlights.why: The guidance shows UK health security work on tick-borne disease, a possible topic for surveillance exchange with European partners.
